# Interoperability Fixtures

This directory holds the small vendored fixtures used for LERC decode
interoperability, parity, and benchmark coverage.

Included fixtures:

- `world.lerc1`: official Esri Lerc1 sample with an external validity mask
- `california_400_400_1_float.lerc2`: official masked float Lerc2 sample
- `bluemarble_256_256_3_byte.lerc2`: official concatenated 3-band byte Lerc2
  sample whose first blob exercises libLerc's integer Huffman encoding
- `liblerc-v4-i8-delta-{1d,3d}[-masked].lerc2`: signed 8-bit delta-Huffman
  blobs generated by libLerc 4.1.1, codec v4, at 64×16 pixels with depth 1 or 3
  and `max_z_error = 0.5`. Samples are `((pixel + dim * 73) % 256) - 128`;
  masked cases mark pixels invalid when divisible by 11 or 17. These exercise
  signed wraparound, row predictors, mask gaps, and dimension-major decoding.
- `esri_js_sanity_u8_3d.csv`: byte-for-byte fixture from Esri's JavaScript
  sanity test covering `depth > 1`
- `gdal-3.12-f32-masked-depth.lerc2`, `gdal-3.12-f32-centimetre-grid.lerc2`:
  single-tile LERC payloads written by GDAL 3.12.2 for the polynomial surfaces
  in `test-support/surfaces.rs`; the writer's GDAL profile must reproduce them
  byte for byte
- `liblerc-v4-u8-huffman-ties.lerc2`: a 48×40 UInt8 Huffman blob generated by
  libLerc 4.2.0 (conda-forge), codec v4, lossless; rasterio 1.5.2's bundled
  libLerc (pre-4.1.0) gives the same bytes only into a zeroed output buffer,
  as it leaves the final read-ahead word, and so the checksum, to the caller. Nine symbols `9 * i` occur 320, 120, 320, 320,
  320, 240, 40, 160 and 80 times, shuffled by xorshift32 (seed `0x2545f491`);
  the tied frequencies give the code lengths of libstdc++'s and the MSVC STL's
  `std::priority_queue`, which libc++'s pop order does not

These files are exercised by:

- `lerc-reader/tests/interop.rs`
- `lerc-reader/tests/huffman.rs`
- `lerc-reader/tests/reference_parity.rs`
- `lerc-reader/benches/reference_compare_bench.rs`
- `lerc-writer/tests/gdal_profile.rs`
